7:00am. One WhatsApp. Three things need you. Twenty-two handled quietly.

You reply OK. Moved, logged, done.

One tap opens maps.

5/ 21:00. Evening wrap.

"Did the Sharma call happen?"

You say yes. Loop closed. It does not ask again.

Persistence with restraint. Amilo never nags.
